text:
deploy-bot: canary deploy v2.5.1 -> cluster-canary1 complete. starting post-deploy synthetics. summary: 47/50 ok, 3 kv-probe timeouts (mostly GET /kv). details: https://deploys.redwood.internal/1797777777
amelia: saw the alert, thanks. 3/50 is high for kv probe, but low overall. any errors in logs?
sam: quick look — timeouts clustered on node canary1-03, lines show `socket_timeout` spikes during rebalance. probably transient.
monitor-bot: metric update: kv_probe_latency p50=380ms p95=1.1s p99=1.9s, error_rate=6% for canary1-03 window=5m
josh: hmm 6% on the node could push the canary to fail safety gates if it persists. do we have a rollback window right now?
rita: change window still open for 2h. rollback plan: revert to v2.5.0 and pin for 1hr if we decide. criteria: >5% failures across canary after re-run OR persistent p95>1s for 15m.
amelia: proposal: don't rollback immediately. try bumping the synthetic probe timeout from 800ms -> 2s and re-run probes once patched. if errors remain >5% after re-run, rollback.
sam: can do. patching canary probe config now -> `kubectl -n infra patch configmap canary-probes --type merge -p '{"data":{"kv_timeout_ms":"2000"}}'`
sam: patch applied, redeploying probe job with new timeout. will kick off runs in ~30s.
monitor-bot: probe job restarted (job-id: probe-1797777777). running 50 probes across canary nodes.
(30m later) monitor-bot: synth run complete: 49/50 ok, 1 kv timeout (node canary1-03). error_rate=2% p95=480ms
josh: nice — that looks stable. any sign of error regression in application logs?
sam: checked tail logs for canary1-03 during run: no new stack traces, just intermittent connection resets to a downstream cache during rebalance.
amelia: OK — no rollback. we'll promote the canary to gradual rollout over next 60m with throttle 20% -> 50% -> 100%. keep probe timeout change in canary config only for now. if we see increase in errors after traffic ramp, revert and execute rollback plan.
rita: noted. I updated the runbook with the decision and pinned v2.5.1 rollout policy: staged.
deploy-bot: scheduled gradual rollout: 20% @ +15m, 50% @ +30m, 100% @ +60m. will post updates. :rocket:
amelia: thanks everyone. closing thread but will post if anything changes. :thumbsup:
